title: Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh (Theme 1: Mapishi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child hears the one feature that separates f/v, s/z, l/r na th/dh and checks the meaning of the word before writing it.

floor.prerequisite: Says the five vowels and reads open syllables (ba, be, bi, bo, bu).
floor.question: Soma: ku-la

representations: a hand on the throat to feel the voice (or the lips for a nasal)
a picture for each meaning (to eat, a vote)
steps: Think of the meaning in the sentence.
Write it and read it back.
contexts: a word game in the playground

board.do: Point at the first letter of each word.
board.say: Neno lipi lina maana ya "to eat"?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes both words under their pictures and says each one.

misconceptions.ask: Neno "kula" lina maana gani, na "kura" lina maana gani?
misconceptions.repair: "kula" ni to eat; "kura" ni a vote. Sauti moja hubadilisha maana.
Neno lenye maana ya "to wash clothes" ni "fua". "vua" lina maana ya "to take off or to fish".

misconceptions.ask: Ukibadilisha neno moja kwa jingine katika sentensi, maana inabaki ileile?
misconceptions.repair: Hapana. "fua" ni to wash clothes, na "vua" ni to take off or to fish.

listen_for: Mama alipika wali na maharagwe jana.
misconceptions.ask: Ni sauti gani zinarudiwa katika sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama f/v, s/z, l/r na th/dh, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.

misconceptions.ask: Kila silabi inaishia kwa herufi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ku-la.

checks.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "to take off or to fish".
Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
checks.answer: Fatuma alifua viatu vya Vivian vilivyofifia.
